name: kaleidosphere
description: A human-in-the-loop AI work operating layer with local assets and explicit execution coordination.

interface.shortDescription: A durable AI work layer with routing and coordination.
interface.longDescription: KaleidoSphere provides durable worksites, global sparks, context recovery, capability routing, and explicit coordination across Agents and projects. This release provides the KS routing entry, runtime repair, local project assets, global spark management, optional version and project-rule management, plus controlled execution coordination and chat-room state for explicitly requested complex work.
interface.defaultPrompt: Orient me in KaleidoSphere. Explain its goal, state the currently available capabilities, and use them only when relevant.
